prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.AI** looks like a sensible starting point: it’s designed for AI-visibility monitoring, covers ChatGPT and several other answer engines, and its entry plan is reported at about **$25–$29/month**. It can track whether your business appears for prompts you choose and how often competitors show up instead.

If you only want a quick baseline, try **HubSpot’s AI Search Grader**, which is listed as a free, one-time diagnostic. For a more tailored check of local-business recommendations, **BrandCompanion** advertises a free ChatGPT audit, but I’d verify its coverage and pricing before relying on it.

One caveat: these tools sample answers to selected prompts; they can’t guarantee what every ChatGPT user will see. Test realistic questions customers might ask—such as “best [service] in [town]”—and compare results over time. Prices and features change, so check the provider’s current plan details before subscribing.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
